Designing a harness for sled dogs

Published Mar 24, 2026

Over the past few winters we have been sewing harnesses for an invented team of sled dogs, and each one taught us something about straps, buckles, padding and the long runs across the frozen bay that test every stitch, every ring and every knot we tie before dawn, while the dogs wait, patient and eager, for the first call of the day.

Notes

A good harness sits behind the shoulders and never rubs.

  • One invented point.
  • Another invented point.

By spring the dogs pulled the sled the whole length of the bay without a single sore.
